normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only flows into the constructor's owner assignment, so it is absorbed by the constructor node.
_from only feeds the ownership/authorization checks inside transferInternal.
_to only feeds the recipient/zero-address checks and balance update inside transferInternal.
_tokenId only indexes the ownership and operator mappings inside transferInternal.
_preminter only writes the preminters reservation inside premintFor.
_tokenId only indexes tokenOwners and tokenOperator inside approve.
_addr only feeds the extcodehash lookup inside isContract.
codehash is the direct output of the extcodehash assembly operation.
accountHash is a constant local used solely for the isContract comparison.
retval only holds and validates the onERC721Received return value inside safeTransferInternal.
retour is a temporary cache of tokenOwners[_tokenId] inside ownerOf.
_owner is a temporary cache of tokenOwners[_tokenId] inside approve.
_data is only forwarded to the receiver callback inside safeTransferInternal.
_from only flows through to transferInternal and the callback inside safeTransferInternal.
_to is only used for isContract and the receiver callback inside safeTransferInternal.
_tokenId only flows through to transferInternal and the callback inside safeTransferInternal.
